name: load-data
title: Load data
source:
import random
random.seed(7)
# Synthetic dataset: two blobs in 2-D. Replace with a real loader; keep `rows` as [(features, label), ...].
rows = []
for _ in range(200):
    label = random.randint(0, 1)
    centre = (0.0, 0.0) if label == 0 else (2.0, 1.5)
    rows.append(([random.gauss(centre[0], 1.0), random.gauss(centre[1], 1.0)], label))
print(f"loaded {len(rows)} rows, {sum(r[1] for r in rows)} positive")
description: Builds a small synthetic two-class dataset with the standard library only (no files, no network). Replace the body with your own loader; keep the name `rows`: a list of (features, label).
